full_judgment:
ATM Afzal CJ: The petitioner was defendant No. 7 in the suit, Title Suit No. 77 of 1987, of the Court of Assistant Judge, Gazipur filed by respondent Nos. 1-4 which was decreed by the trial Court but on appeal was dismissed. The aggrieved plaintiffs took a revision to the High Court Division, Civil Revision No. 3903 of 1997, against the appellate judgment and decree and a learned Single Judge, who heard the matter, by the impugned judgment and order dated 3rd May, 1998, discharged the Rule upholding the judgment and decree passed by the lower appellate Court. 

 3. Khondkar Mahbubuddin Ahmed, learned Advocate for the petitioner, submits that the impugned observations were unwarranted because the defendant's title was not in issue in the suit and the decree of the appellate Court dismissing the plaintiffs'' suit could be affirmed without making the said observations. Mr. Ahmed submits that the defendant-petitioner has evidently been prejudiced by the observations because he would be at a great disadvantage in any future litigation over the disputed property due to the said observations which may, therefore, be deleted.
